latin: Sicut angelus necessario componitur ex essentia et esse, ita anima necessario componitur ex substantia et accidente.
translation: An angel's composition is, of necessity, out of essence and existence; the soul's composition, equally of necessity, is out of substance and accident.
translation_note: 'substantia'/'accidens' here denote the soul's intellectual and rational parts respectively, on Pico's usage elsewhere (cf. 3>59, 3>61); sense checked.
